dg-tropica-scissors-25cm.title: Tropica Plant Scissors 25 cm (S-curved)
dg-tropica-scissors-25cm.summary: Long, S-shaped aquascaping scissors for trimming aquarium plants. The S-shape also makes them handy in smaller tanks. Regular trimming keeps carpets dense and stem plants bushy.

dg-tropica-tweezers-25cm.title: Tropica Planting Tweezers 25 cm
dg-tropica-tweezers-25cm.summary: Long stainless steel tweezers that make planting easier in new and established aquariums, from tiny carpeting plants to larger plants. They're also the easy way to push fertilizer capsules down into the substrate and to replant trimmed stem tops.
notes: How to plant: grip the plant at the roots, press it down into the gravel to where you want it, then let go gently and slide the tweezers out.
